Baked Cinnamon Apple Slices
By: Jennifer
Published: Friday, June 3, 2011 - 9:42pm

Ingredients




4 Apples Sliced and Peeled – whatever type of apples I have in my refrigerator
1/2 cup of Raisins
1 1/2 tablespoons of Cinnamon
2 tablespoons of Earth Balance – melted

Preparation

1 Mix ingredients together except the raisins.  Place in baking dish and in oven at 350 Degrees for 30 minutes. 2 Add raisins the last 5 minutes of baking. 3 Serve and enjoy! 4 Use Organic Ingredients if Available
